_note: SAMPLE DATA. Replace names, instructions and lat/lng with your real campus route. Walk the route once and record coordinates at each turn.

destinations.name: Computer Science Department

route.instruction: From the main gate, walk straight along the main road for about 100 metres.
route.landmark_hint: A security cabin on your right

route.instruction: At the fountain roundabout, take the path on the left.
route.landmark_hint: You may hear running water from the fountain

route.instruction: Continue straight past the canteen for about 60 metres.
route.landmark_hint: Canteen on your right, usually noisy and smells of food

route.instruction: Turn right at the notice board onto the paved walkway.
route.landmark_hint: A large notice board with a sign reading 'Academic Block'

route.instruction: Walk about 40 metres. The CS building will be directly ahead.
route.landmark_hint: Three-storey building with a ramp on the left of the stairs

destinations.entrance: Main entrance is glass double doors at the top of 4 steps, with a ramp on the left side. Sign above the door reads 'Department of Computer Science and Engineering'.

rooms.CS-101: Ground floor. Enter, walk straight 10 metres, first door on the right.
rooms.CS-204: First floor. Lift is to the left of the entrance. Exit lift, turn right, fourth door on the left.
rooms.lab 3: Ground floor. Enter, turn left, end of corridor. Door has a 'Lab 3' sign at eye level.

destinations.name: Central Library

route.instruction: From the main gate, walk straight along the main road for about 100 metres.
route.landmark_hint: A security cabin on your right

route.instruction: At the fountain roundabout, take the path on the right.
route.landmark_hint: You may hear running water from the fountain

route.instruction: Walk straight for about 80 metres. The library is on your left.
route.landmark_hint: Quiet area, large building with tall pillars

destinations.entrance: Entrance is a revolving door between two pillars, with an accessible side door on the right. Sign reads 'Central Library'.

rooms.reading hall: Ground floor, straight ahead after the security desk.
rooms.reference section: First floor, turn left at the top of the stairs.
